summary: No box all round: the fleet's three other boxes held 1.056 of the 1.2 $/h cap from 08:44 to the end, so every box.py rent (every 90 s, 08:44-19:16 UTC) was refused; no run, no eval, no score. Work done on the agent host's CPU: (1) the loop's 92.54% line k04 falls into the final shaft's first kill sheet; the shaft is a stack of kill sheets with alternating gaps; (2) two 5-min Go-Explore look-aheads (the loop's GE settings) rooted at k04's own states reached the finish box -> spine autoresearch/spines/pbr8b2_f1 = k04 + 2 exact reward-free chains, the first line from the true start to the finish (~78.4 s); (3) probes: c9's weights handle f1 up to ~84.5% only; (4) new generic flags --auto-spine-cut-secs / --auto-spine-cut-beyond (default off, bit-identical, CPU-tested 8/8), never run on a box. Next: resume the incumbent on f1 with autoresearch/spines/pbr8b2_f1.flags.txt.
